blockers: The face is an almost featureless white oval at native scale; the tiny eyes and mouth do not establish a deliberate expression and read closer to a generic mannequin than a controlled, aristocratic duelist.

The silhouette is too narrow and vertically uniform. The large blue leg shapes, compressed torso, and thin lower legs create a pinched hourglass that does not clearly communicate corset, skirt, armor, or stance.

The locomotion cycle has insufficient readable weight. Leg swaps are small and stiff, with little convincing compression, passing position, extension, or recovery; several frames look like pose substitutions rather than a coherent walk.

The character's signature rapier is not consistently legible across directions and frames. It frequently collapses into a thin diagonal artifact or disappears into the legs, eliminating a major identity cue.

The gesture strip does not present a strongly readable signature action. The arm and weapon changes are subtle, and the sequence lacks a clear anticipation, decisive line of action, overshoot, and settle.

The palette is much brighter and more saturated cyan-blue than the stated midnight navy/obsidian intent. Bright armor highlights dominate the read, while dark materials merge with the checkerboard and lose structural separation.

The 4x enlargement exposes soft, painterly gradients and blurry highlight transitions rather than a disciplined retro pixel cluster language. At native scale, these gradients collapse into noisy value patches.

Front, rear, and oblique silhouettes are overly similar in mass and posture. Direction changes mostly rotate the same rigid mannequin instead of revealing distinct torso, hip, shoulder, and weapon rhythms.
high_value_changes: Redesign the native 192px silhouette around three unmistakable masses: high collar/head, corseted torso, and controlled split lower-body shape. Add a clearer shoulder-to-hip counter-curve and a more deliberate foot stance without exceeding the 128px height contract.

Replace broad smooth gradients with a compact value hierarchy: near-black obsidian base, readable navy midtone, restrained blue edge light, and small brass accents. Ensure every material retains at least one native-scale separating cluster from adjacent materials.

Rebuild the walk as a weighted eight-frame cycle before expanding it to all directions: contact, down/compression, passing, up, opposite contact, and recovery. Keep the ground anchor fixed while varying pelvis, torso, and head with controlled counter-motion.

Make the rapier a persistent silhouette feature. Establish a direction-specific resting angle, readable guard, and consistent hand attachment; prevent the blade from intersecting the legs or vanishing against dark values.

Give the gesture a clear restrained performance arc: still anticipation, precise draw or presentation, held apex, controlled recoil, and exact return. The action should read when frames are viewed as thumbnails.

Simplify the face into a few intentional native-scale clusters: stable hairline/head contour, separated eye placement, a readable nose or shadow plane, and a tiny controlled mouth mark. Do not rely on a white oval with isolated colored pixels.
Use the silhouette mask as a shipping gate for every direction and key pose. If the pose cannot be identified without color, the design is not carrying enough shape information.
optional_notes: The measured 119.8px standing height and 0px anchor drift satisfy the stated technical contract, but contract compliance does not compensate for weak visual and kinetic readability.
The native inspection is more useful than the enlarged sheet for judging the sprite; at 1x, the face, rapier, hands, and brass trim are near the threshold of disappearing.
The intended contained personality is currently reading as static and under-animated rather than controlled. Restraint still requires timing contrast, poised asymmetry, and deliberate holds.
The checkerboard background makes the dark legs and blade difficult to inspect. Validate against both dark and light in-game backgrounds, especially for the weapon and footwear.
regressions_from_previous: No previous-round visual sheet or change log was supplied, so specific regressions cannot be verified.

Relative to the stated character intent, the current round appears to regress toward bright cyan armor and generic mannequin construction rather than midnight navy, corseted elegance, and restrained duelist identity.
strongest_improvements: Standing height and ground anchoring are technically disciplined.
The high collar, blue armor treatment, brass accent, and narrow vertical proportion provide a usable starting identity.
Eight-direction coverage is comprehensive and the major directional silhouettes remain broadly consistent.
The static sheet includes both native-scale and enlarged inspection views, making the readability problems diagnosable.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Rebuild one native-scale front-facing walk cycle and its silhouette mask around a stronger asymmetric duelist pose, with a clearly attached and persistent rapier, readable torso-to-hip rhythm, and intentional facial clusters before propagating the design to all directions and gesture frames.
